notice: Derived extraction; authentication, transport envelopes and payload staging omitted. Original hash is in the disposition manifest. Device output is an observation, not proof of emitted light.

observations.command:
set -eu
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
test -x /usr/bin/input_keyevent
test "$(sha256sum /usr/bin/input_keyevent | cut -d " " -f1)" = 7284ad5b0117a96a166a4fe327c6361bea998e5d2086a0e1a36d2a3477a87db9
down_status=0
/usr/bin/input_keyevent Left down >/dev/null 2>&1 || down_status=$?
sleep 0.15
up_status=0
/usr/bin/input_keyevent Left up >/dev/null 2>&1 || up_status=$?
printf "LOCAL_KEY_DOWN_EXIT=%s\n" "$down_status"
printf "LOCAL_KEY_UP_EXIT=%s\n" "$up_status"
